chapter: Porgy and Bess and Varsity Show
title: George Gershwin chooses him for Sportin' Life
summary: Gershwin went through his manager after seeing him perform repeatedly and chose him for Sportin' Life in Porgy and Bess, a first step beyond his act.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them

blocks.x: So now you're back with your act, then. The next major stepping stone is "Porgy and Bess."
How did George Gershwin get to you? Why did he choose you?
Where did he see you perform?
world of entertainment. He caught me out at one of the theaters some place. He had to catch me. He see me more than one time.
Yup. He chose me to do Sportin' Life in "Porgy and Bess."
How did you feel about that, that he chose you?
All right. I didn't know that I didn't like the part until I got it. I didn't know how to work with it until I got it either. But after I learned the part --
Well, this was your first time really doing something that was outside of your act.
So now you're sort of dabbing into acting.
That going into opera. Acting is right.
Did you feel a little insecure about that?

No. What they give me, I can handle what they give me. I can handle what they give me, man, he like give me a hot fork, some hot spoon, a hot knife, I can hold that. If you hand me something I can handle, okay. I can do with it.
